+	require.NoError(t, err)

+	commit := &object.Commit{
+		Message:   "init orphan",
+		TreeHash:  treeHash,
+		Author:    object.Signature{Name: "t", Email: "t@example.com", When: when},

+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	return commitHash
